notes.title: Developer Plays - Borderwatch: Dark Armada NextFest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43769289/caf589c4f864c7dbc522c1aaf20b80d779857c23.png[/img]

Dear players,

Borderwatch Dark Armada Demo is now playable at Steam NextFest! Our developer will play and answer your questions about the game. Don't forget to try it with your friends!

Thanks!

--

What to expect from our community?

* Meeting up with fellow cultists!
* Our game giveaways
* Sneak Peaks from our newest creations
* News about our upcoming games
* Being a part of a great family 🙂

We wish to see you on our livestream, 👋

You can also follow us from these links

https://linktr.ee/Blackburne
